metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Sweatshirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film sweatshirts for your team or event. Vibrant, durable prints. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct-to-film (DTF) decoration gives your custom sweatshirts a soft hand feel and vivid, crack-resistant graphics that hold up wash after wash. Unlike screen printing, DTF allows full-color designs without setup fees, making it ideal for smaller runs or complex logos. Whether you're outfitting a safety crew or launching a company store, DTF delivers sharp detail on cotton, poly, or blends.
heroAltText: Group of custom direct to film sweatshirts featuring vibrant full-color logos and soft fabric texture
